name: Arabic Complaints Classifier — single best model
description: Single-model deploy variant. Uses CAMeLBERT-mix capALL with EDA augmentation (best single from bake-off). Test acc 94.86%, mF1 91.22%. ~440 MB on disk, ~16ms CPU latency, ~4ms GPU latency. Trade-off: ~0.2% acc loss vs 4-model ensemble for 4x faster + 4x smaller deploy.
